subject: Arbor Health discovery — decision criteria, security owners, and contract routing
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Price <daniel.price@arborhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Arbor Health discovery — initial recap & next steps

Hi Daniel — thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared plan: 

What we heard
- Primary use case: routing clinical notes for near-real-time summarization and embedding-based retrieval for clinician workflows.
- Decision criteria: latency under 350ms p95 for short prompts, HIPAA-friendly deployment options (VPC/private), predictable unit cost per 1k tokens.
- Pilot goal: validate accuracy on 3-4 representative workflows, measure latency and cost, and define SLA needs for production.

Suggested owners (to align on internal routing)
- Economic buyer / contract sign: Daniel Price (you)
- Procurement / PO: Linda Gomez (procurement@arborhealth.com) — please confirm
- Security / compliance: Priya Shah (pshah@arborhealth.com) — please confirm

Immediate next steps
1) NDA: we can push a two-way NDA to DocuSign — I attached a draft NDA and our one-pager. Target turnaround: 48 hours if possible. (attachments: draft-nda-Arbor-20260814.docx, redwood-one-pager.pdf)
2) Security kickoff: Soojin will coordinate a short security Q&A (SOC2, data retention, KMS).
3) Commercial outline & pilot SOW: Ben will share a lightweight pilot SOW and ballpark economics for the 6-week evaluation.
4) Procurement checklist: Linda — please send your standard PO/contract requirements and preferred billing cadence.

If that matches your expectations, can you: (a) confirm the procurement and security contacts, (b) say if a mutual NDA is acceptable, and (c) indicate any hard deal dates we should be aware of?

Thanks — happy to align cadence.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0113

Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf (1 page)
Attachment: draft-nda-Arbor-20260814.docx (stub)

From: Daniel Price <daniel.price@arborhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <pshah@arborhealth.com>, Linda Gomez <linda.gomez@arborhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Arbor Health discovery — initial recap & next steps

Thanks Olga — great summary and appreciated the call. Confirming contacts:
- Security & privacy: Priya Shah (I put her on cc)
- Procurement: Linda Gomez (cc'd)

A few clarifications from our side: 
- NDA: mutual NDA is fine. If you can push via DocuSign we'd prefer that.
- Pilot timing: we're targeting a late September start (internal calendar constraints).
- Pricing: send ballpark pilot pricing and any overage rules. We'll need an estimate of expected monthly spend during pilot for PO approval.
- Decision criteria: clinical accuracy (F1-type metrics against our labeled set), latency (p95), and data governance (where logs are stored).

I'll expect Ben to follow up on pricing and SOW. Priya, Linda — feel free to add specific requirements.

— Daniel
Daniel Price
VP Product | Arbor Health
daniel.price@arborhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-2010

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Price <daniel.price@arborhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Arbor Health discovery — initial recap & next steps

Great — thanks Daniel. Looping in the owners internally and proposing a sequencing to keep procurement moving: 

Proposed sequencing (short, actionable):
1) NDA (mutual) — DocuSign sent today; target turnaround 48–72 hours. This unblocks sharing of sample datasets and security artifacts. (DocuSign link sent in related_links)
2) Security Q&A — Soojin to schedule a 45-minute call next week. Primary asks: SOC2 scope, encryption/KMS options, log retention, and data deletion policy. Estimated internal turn time: 3–5 business days for initial evidence bundle. Attachment: security-evidence-stub.zip (placeholder).
3) Pilot SOW & pricing — Ben will send a two-page SOW + pilot pricing. We recommend a 6-week pilot with a capped spend for PO. Expect an initial estimate within 24 hours.
4) Procurement paperwork — Linda, if you can return the PO template and standard terms we will align commercial and billing cadence. Suggested contract lane: NDA → Pilot SOW (purchase order) → MSA/DPA negotiation (if pilot results look good).

Proposed internal owners for routing:
- Commercial & pricing: Ben Carter
- Security & compliance: Soojin Lee
- Contracts & redlines (MSA/DPA): Marissa Cole (I asked her to monitor turn times & prioritize)

Turn-time expectations for negotiation (ballpark)
- NDA: 2–3 business days once routed
- Security evidence bundle: 3–5 business days for initial answers; deeper requests may take 7–10 business days
- MSA/DPA redlines: typical 7–14 business days depending on counterparty edits; if legal routing requires multiple internal signoffs we can escalate to an exec approval lane.

Ben — sending a quick SOW and price estimate now. Marissa — please confirm you can take the contract lead and share any gating questions.

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

From: Linda Gomez <linda.gomez@arborhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Procurement info / PO form & billing questions

Hi Olga/Ben — attaching our standard PO form and a short checklist of procurement requirements. A few asks from procurement: 
- Estimated total value for the pilot (we need to know for approval routing)
- Preferred billing cadence (monthly or milestone-based) and whether vendor accepts net-30 terms
- W-9 and corporate info (I'll need Redwood's registered name and tax ID)

Attachment: Arbor_Standard_PO_Form.pdf (1 page)

We're aiming to process a PO within 5 business days after receiving the SOW and estimated value. If you can provide a short commercial summary (line item + amount) it will speed review.

Thanks,
Linda Gomez
Senior Procurement Manager | Arbor Health
linda.gomez@arborhealth.com | +1 (857) 555-3221

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@arborhealth.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Security kickoff & evidence items for Arbor Health pilot

Hi Priya / team — thanks for joining the thread. Quick note on how we suggest the security onboarding run so we don't block the pilot start: 

1) Short security kickoff (30–45 min) — review SOC2 scope, data flows, ingress/egress controls, and encryption/KMS approach. Proposed slots: Thu 8/19 or Fri 8/20.
2) Evidence bundle (initial): SOC2 report (redacted), infra diagram, data retention policy, DLP/PII handling notes. I'll attach a placeholder bundle for now (security-evidence-stub.zip).
3) DPA highlights: key items we expect from customers are data retention windows, logging requests, and export controls. We will send a draft DPA alongside the MSA; Marissa will lead redline coordination.

A couple of clarifying questions for Priya: do you have a preference for KMS (Azure Key Vault vs AWS KMS) or would you require an HSM-managed key? Also, is your InfoSec team comfortable with limited, time-bounded access to logs for troubleshooting during the pilot?

Marissa — I'll flag the DPA/MSA for your intake. Ben — please confirm pilot SOW + ballpark so Linda can route the PO.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Security & Trust Lead | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

Attachment: security-evidence-stub.zip (placeholder)
